meta.title: Football, Visualized

playground.title: Build the chance.

playground.pitchDescription: Attacking half of the pitch with movable strikers, center-backs and a goalkeeper. Drag a player or focus one and use the arrow keys.
playground.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move this player. Hold Shift for larger steps.
